insight: Pairs vector search with an LLM-built knowledge graph so recall can follow relationships, not just nearest-neighbor similarity.
name: Cognee
description: An open-source semantic memory layer for AI agents. Cognee ingests documents, relational data, and system context, then runs an Extract-Cognify-Load pipeline that uses an LLM to build a knowledge graph with embeddings and relationships. Agents query it for durable, cross-session context that captures how concepts connect. Self-host the Python SDK for free, or use the managed cloud tiers.

modelSupport.notes: Bring your own LLM and embedding provider for the cognify pipeline.
